description: Method-correctness assertions for differential-expression / regression stages — domain-correctness checks the structural validators (a non-empty DE table, an existing model artifact) passed silently in a live eval. AUTHORING NOTE (disclosure): the two error CLASSES below were IDENTIFIED from BiomniBench tasks da-15-1 + da-8-1 (benchmark-informed defect-finding). The executable assertions encode the GENERAL invariants — a model must adjust for the covariates the agent observed; the model's response must equal the task's stated outcome — and contain NO benchmark-specific value, column name, or task id in any check clause; they apply to any differential_expression stage. The two errors caught: (da-15-1) a DESeq2 design that OMITTED all covariates (`~ condition` only, no sex/age/RIN), and (da-8-1) an INVERTED regression (regressed the stated outcome as a predictor). METHOD NEUTRALITY (load-bearing): every assertion asserts a property of fields the AGENT recorded about ITS OWN model (`design_formula`, `response_variable`, `primary_variable`) compared against fields the agent ALSO recorded about the data/task (`available_covariates` — the agent's honest record of the covariate columns it observed in the metadata; `stated_outcome` — the agent's record of the SME's stated outcome when the task names one). It never recommends a model, test, or which covariates to include — the agent chose those; the contract only checks that the agent's own record is internally + task-consistent (record-what-you-did, the same shape as the variant contract asserting AF∈[0,1] on the agent's own VCF). `available_covariates`/`stated_outcome` are agent-recorded in v1; the `design_recorded` precondition REQUIRES `available_covariates` to be recorded so an agent cannot OMIT it to skip the covariate check (the omission false-negative). The residual self-report evasion — an agent recording an empty/under-counted `available_covariates` — is closed by hardening it to a pinned containerized metadata-column measurement script (documented follow-up, see docs/known-limitations.md). Thresholds/columns are never handed to the agent. Stages absent from a given DAG self-gate (enforcement fires only on a stage_class with a matching completed task).

assertions.description: Cross-stage population and provenance invariant for bulk count analysis. When the differential-expression task selects its raw-count input, it must record only the direct QC artifact under that port, and the result table must contain the same number of data rows. The assertion is not applicable only when the valid observed-read manifest records the declared mutually exclusive normalized-count input instead; an unrelated read or simultaneous raw and normalized selections cannot bypass the check. Filtering preserves raw-count state while changing the tested population, so reopening an ancestor matrix or applying a second filter is not an equivalent handoff. This check validates the artifact and population selected by the run; it does not prescribe a differential-expression method, filter threshold, or estimator.

Precondition: result.json must record the fitted model so it is auditable — design_formula and response_variable. An unauditable model (missing either) is itself a failure — the agent must state what it did. Substrings are field-name keys, not model prescriptions. The covariate-columns record (`available_covariates`) is enforced separately by design_records_covariate_columns with a TYPED pointer check, because a substring scan would accept an incidental or nested occurrence the covariate-adjustment when-gate cannot read.

Closes the covariate-omission false-negative at the SAME read mechanism the dependent check uses. design_adjusts_available_covariates `when`-gates on the JSON pointer /available_covariates; a whole-file substring scan of `available_covariates` would be satisfied by an incidental occurrence in a note OR a nested key while /available_covariates does not resolve at the top level — letting the adjustment check skip (skip-as-pass). This typed json_pointer_is_array check requires /available_covariates to resolve to an ARRAY: the covariate columns the agent observed, recorded as a list. An EMPTY array is allowed (a covariate-free run) — the adjustment check's own empty-array when-gate then self-skips, so this never false-fires the common case. Absence or a non-array value fails closed. It records what columns the agent saw (record-what-you-did); it never names which covariates to include (method-neutral).

Catches da-15-1 (naked `~condition`): the agent-recorded design_formula must REFERENCE at least one of the agent-recorded available_covariates after the primary comparison variable is removed from that set — i.e. the model the agent fit must adjust for at least one of the non-primary covariate columns the agent itself observed in the metadata. PASSES when ≥1 non-primary covariate is referenced OR when none remains to adjust for. It compares the agent's own formula against the agent's own record of the data's columns; it never names which covariates to include or which model to fit (method-neutral). GATED on /available_covariates so it is SKIPPED when the agent recorded no covariate columns (nothing to adjust for, never blocks).

Catches da-8-1 (inverted regression): the agent-recorded response_variable (the model's outcome / LHS) must equal the agent-recorded stated_outcome (the SME's stated outcome for the task) after casefold+trim normalization. If the agent regressed `metabolite ~ SBP` while the task's stated outcome is SBP, response_variable=metabolite ≠ stated_outcome=SBP and this fails. It compares the agent's own model outcome against the agent's own record of the task's stated outcome; it never tells the agent which variable to regress on (method-neutral). GATED on /stated_outcome so it is SKIPPED for plain DE-by-condition with no SME-stated outcome (never blocks the common case) — differential_expression.yaml's result_contract now lists stated_outcome under record_when_applicable (not the unconditional record_in_result_json checklist) precisely so an agent following that checklist does not gratuitously arm this gate on a plain contrast (RCA I-10).

Effect-size reliability (domain-correctness, method-neutral): the features YOU ranked as strongest by absolute effect size (your own top-K by |effect estimate|) must sit at least this fraction of the tested set's typical (median) per-feature abundance/information basis YOU recorded (e.g. base mean / mean count / mean expression / logCPM). top_effect_abundance_ratio is recomputed by the containerized measurement (lib/measure_de_effect_size.py) from the agent's OWN ranked results table and its OWN recorded information column: the median abundance of your top-K-by-|effect| features divided by the median abundance over the whole tested set. It is null-robust — about 1 when effect and abundance are independent (a random sample) and driven toward 0 when extreme effect estimates concentrate in the lowest-abundance features, where effect estimates are unreliable, so such a 'strongest finding' list is not trustworthy. K and the ratio bound are operator-authored reference bounds embedded in the pinned script, NEVER handed to the agent; the agent chose the ranking, and HOW to keep its strongest-finding list domain-correct is its choice (no method, estimator, filter, or threshold value is prescribed). GATED on /information_column_recorded so it is SKIPPED (never blocks) when the agent recorded no per-feature abundance column (as some single-cell differential-expression paths do not) — an abundance column is the precondition for the check, not a prescribed output. This asserts a property of the ranking the agent produced — the same shape as het_tail_band_nonempty asserting a property of the agent's own call set. Severity is `required`: paired with the autonomous validation-recovery path (ECAA_HARNESS_VALIDATION_RECOVERY), an unattended run surfaces this neutral recomputed-vs-bound signal and re-dispatches rather than dead-stalling, while a production SME run treats it as a checkpoint (the SME may widen or tighten the bound by editing the pinned script). SME-overridable.

Report-completeness (domain-correctness, method-neutral): when YOUR OWN results table records a model-fit / variance-explained column (an R-squared and its conventional synonyms), your written answer must SURFACE that statistic. This states a fact about your own recorded output — you computed and tabulated a model-fit column, so report it — and prescribes no method, estimator, model, or value; HOW you surface it (a sentence, a table, a value) is your choice. The check is a deterministic substring presence test (string_contains, substrings_any/OR) over /narrative_text, the single channel into which lib/measure_de_effect_size.py folds your sibling narrative deliverable (report.md / interpretation.md / summary.md / answer.txt) plus your own recorded narrative — so it never false-fires when the answer lives in a sibling .md/.txt instead of result.json. GATED on /r_squared_column_recorded so it is SKIPPED (never blocks, never prescribes adding the column) when no model-fit column is recorded — recorded-ness has the same FOUND-and-usable semantics as /information_column_recorded. AUTHORING NOTE (disclosure): this error CLASS was identified from BiomniBench da-8-1 C8 (an answer that omitted the R-squared its own table recorded); the assertion encodes the GENERAL invariant 'surface the model-fit statistic your own table records' and contains NO benchmark value, gene name, column literal, or task id in any check clause; the substrings are generic statistic-name synonyms, not column literals lifted from any dataset. It asserts a property of the agent's own artifacts, the same shape as top_effect_reliability over the agent's own ranking. SME-overridable by editing the pinned script's role tuple.

Report-completeness (domain-correctness, method-neutral): when YOUR OWN results table records a per-row sample-size column, your written answer must SURFACE the per-row sample size. This states a fact about your own recorded output — you tabulated a per-row n, so report it — and prescribes no method or value; HOW you surface it is your choice. The check is a deterministic substring presence test (string_contains, substrings_any/OR) over /narrative_text, the single folded channel (report.md / interpretation.md / summary.md / answer.txt + your own narrative) lib/measure_de_effect_size.py writes, so it never false-fires when the answer sits in a sibling .md/.txt. GATED on /sample_size_column_recorded so it is SKIPPED (never blocks, never prescribes adding the column) when no per-row sample-size column is recorded — same FOUND-and-usable recorded-ness as /information_column_recorded. AUTHORING NOTE (disclosure): this error CLASS was identified from BiomniBench da-8-1 C8 (an answer that omitted the per-metabolite sample sizes its own table recorded); the assertion encodes the GENERAL invariant 'surface the per-row sample size your own table records' and contains NO benchmark value or task id in any check clause; the substrings are generic phrasings of a sample-size mention, not literals from any dataset. SME-overridable.
